items.text: The Eagles will play their first game on Sunday without Jalen Hurts. Tanner McKee starts.
items.implication: McKee under center with healthy top-4 pass-catchers but thin RB room.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday. Ravens will play another game without him.
items.why: Ankle injury; official Friday ruling and ETR roundup.
items.implication: Start backup QB; fade Ravens pass game ceiling.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for remaining Ravens skill players and TE options.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers. Will Shipley also OUT.
items.implication: PHI RB room extremely thin; Tanner McKee starting at QB.
items.opportunity: 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce elevated role; pass-catchers see more volume.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams. Resting for long-term.
items.why: Ankle; official ruling to rest it.
items.implication: ARI RB committee shifts; fade Love short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining ARI backs.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown practiced all week on a limited basis; listed questionable.
items.why: Limited practice all week; earlier than expected full participation notes.
items.opportunity: If OUT, NE WR targets open; if IN, normal role.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday addition Q. Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle Q tags seem more probable. PIT thin WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) expecting 2-WR Metcalf/Bernard. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice trends and Friday additions; PIT depth chart notes.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson/Moore closely; lean start on probable Qs; Metcalf volume up in 2-WR; PHI pass-catchers safe with McKee.
items.opportunity: PIT 2-WR sets boost Metcalf routes; PHI targets concentrated.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT along with AD Mitchell.
items.implication: Jets RB opportunity opens for backups.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB snaps and carries spike.
Increased role for other HOU RBs.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed OUT along with Tyquan Thornton.
IN/cleared: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday injuries IN list.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday’s game. Cleared/IN.
Caleb Williams officially listed as questionable for Sunday’s game.
items.implication: Levitan views as more probable; monitor.
items.opportunity: If active, normal QB volume vs ATL.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4. Washington defense is a buffet for pass catchers; all-in on Evans top-5 WR play.
items.why: Elite matchup vs Commanders secondary; usage bankable.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone expectation in favorable spot.

items.text: LOVES: Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ), Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH), Stafford, Jordan Love. HATES: Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT), Kyle Pitts, J.K. Dobbins (vs SEA), Bo Nix (vs SEA), Justin Herbert (@KC). Notes Hurts OUT/McKee.
items.why: Volume + leaking run Ds for RBs; high-scoring/pass-friendly for QBs/PCs; ugly matchups/QB issues for hates.
items.implication: Prioritize loves in lineups; fade hates especially tough D spots.
items.opportunity: Kyren elite usage; Javonte goal-line; Purdy/Kittle vs WSH buffet.
